**Finding: Compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

- **§14 Termination** (p0079): no early-termination fee or acceleration of remaining contract value; Client pays only for services through the last day of the month following its termination notice.
- **§13 Term** (p0078): non-renewal on 30 days' notice with no charge; only operational transition duties (new name server/hosting environment).
- **§7 Spam** (p0049): a conduct prohibition with no per-incident penalty or fixed damages figure.
- **§5 Compensation** (p0045): minimum monthly Hosting/Support fees are an in-term pricing commitment for services rendered, not a liquidated sum triggered by breach or termination, so outside this rule's scope.

No Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties exist, matching our preferred position — no redline proposed.
